description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT against a DataCanvas table staged by fema_search_nfip. Enables aggregation, GROUP BY, SUM/COUNT, time-series, and filtered analysis over the full NFIP claims result without re-fetching from the API. Call fema_dataframe_describe first to get the exact table name and column names needed for valid SQL. Only SELECT statements are allowed — DDL, DML, COPY, and file-reading functions are blocked. A response holds at most 100,000 characters of rows; when it holds fewer rows than the query returned, truncated and shown are set and the notice says how to page with OFFSET.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID from the fema_search_nfip response (the canvas_id field).

query.description: SQL SELECT statement to run against the staged table. Use the table name from fema_dataframe_describe. Results are capped at the canvas row limit and at 100,000 characters of rows; append LIMIT/OFFSET, under an ORDER BY, to page through additional rows, or aggregate (GROUP BY, COUNT, SUM) to summarize the full set in one query. Example: "SELECT year_of_loss, COUNT(*) AS claims, SUM(amount_paid_building) AS total_building_paid FROM df_nfip_abc123 GROUP BY year_of_loss ORDER BY year_of_loss"

name: fema_dataframe_query

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID that was queried — reuse for follow-up queries.

cap.description: The canvas row limit, present only when it capped the result. Absent when only the response budget cut it.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_unavailable`: DataCanvas is disabled on this deployment (CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE is not set to duckdb). `canvas_not_found`: The canvas_id does not correspond to an active canvas session. `missing_table`: The SELECT names a table that is not staged on this canvas — misspelled, dropped, or expired. `invalid_sql`: A SELECT fails to prepare — an unknown column, function, or type, or an invalid expression. `non_select_statement`: The statement is not a SELECT (DDL, DML, PRAGMA, EXPLAIN, ATTACH) or cannot be parsed. `multi_statement`: The query holds more than one SQL statement. `denied_function`: The SELECT calls a blocked function — a file reader, an engine-setting reader, or query()/query_table() over anything but one literal SELECT. `plan_operator_not_allowed`: The query plan uses an operator outside the read-only allowlist, such as a table function like range() or a system catalog like information_schema. `sql_read_only`: The statement writes or names a file, such as COPY … TO or a quoted file path in FROM. `sql_execution_error`: A SELECT fails while converting or calculating values in the staged data. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Continuation guidance when truncated — how far to advance OFFSET, and lower any LIMIT, under an ORDER BY, to page the remainder.

row_count.description: Number of rows in this response — fewer than the query returned when truncated is set.

rows.description: Result rows from the query, bounded by the canvas row limit and by 100,000 characters of rows — when the truncated enrichment field is set, page the remainder with OFFSET (see the notice guidance).

items.description: A single result row — keys are column names from the SELECT, values are the computed data.

shown.description: Number of rows in this truncated response — the amount to advance OFFSET by, and to lower any LIMIT by, for the next page.

truncated.description: True when more rows match than this response holds: the result was capped at the canvas row limit, or cut at the 100,000-character response budget.

title: Query FEMA DataCanvas Table
